edges.subject: CHEBI:29033
edges.description: In the 2016 metal-substitution assay, Fe2+ supported 100 ± 4.6% activity relative to Fe2+ = 100%; the apo row is 4.0 ± 0.33%. Assay: 50 µM CHM and 50 µM metal, 100 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 25°C; apoenzyme received at least 1 h preincubation. Metal stripping used 1 mM EDTA for 12 h at 4°C followed by washing. Fe2+ was incubated anaerobically on ice; other metal-substitution preparation is described at 15°C. This is conditional reconstitution, not physiological cofactor exclusivity.

edges.subject: NCBIProtein:BAI50711.1
edges.description: The 2016 Comamonas sp. E6 PmdE/LigJ preparation substitutes for GalB in the GalA–GalD–hydratase–GalC coupled assay, giving 1:1 NADH oxidation relative to added gallate. With GalD omitted, only slow hydratase-independent turnover remains. Polarimetry identifies the same negative CHA enantiomer as GalB, without proving absolute S configuration. The source uses the GalD-generated E,E enol; this exact E6 construct is distinct from the older native PmdE homology annotation and modern SYK-6 keto-KCH reaction.

edges.subject: UniProtKB:E8ZB61
edges.description: The broad activity label is scoped here to repaired KTGAL GalT: gallate uptake and less efficient protocatechuate uptake in whole cells. The 449-residue allele is distinct from the inactive KT2440 frameshift annotation. Gallate/PCA Vmax values 8.4/3.2 nmol/min/mg and Km 4.3/9.1 µM are reported; the adjacent prose emphasizes pIZGalT whereas Figure 2B caption names GA-induced KTGAL, so the complete kinetic series is not uniformly reassigned to the multicopy construct. Tested 50 µM negatives remain conditional. No proton stoichiometry or direct ligand-binding measurement is inferred.

evidence.source_assertion: FUNCTION assigns gallate uptake with ECO:0000269/PMID21219457; CAUTION distinguishes the functional sequence from the KT2440 frameshift. GO0046943 is separately an IEA:TreeGrafter annotation.

edge_updates.description: Historical purified Comamonas/Pseudomonas testosteroni protocatechuate 4,5-dioxygenase gallate activity (1972/1982 references). The native complex identity is retained; modern sequence cross-references do not establish the historical assayed sequence.
Historical Comamonas CHA aldolase activity in crude or partly purified preparations. The source-native complex and its historical evidence remain distinct from current genome proteins.

Purified SYK-6 DesB produced in E. coli BL21(DE3) with pETB/pET21a(+). The encoded 418-residue reference has a processed initiating methionine in the assayed preparation. Gallate-dependent oxygen consumption gives Vmax 42.7 ± 2.4 U/mg and Km 66.9 ± 9.3 µM (2005 Table 2). Late acidified GC-MS supports OMA enol but does not alone determine the immediate keto product; native formal chemistry and the independent GalA product work supply that distinction. In the separate 500 µM substrate screen (30°C, pH 8.5), pyrogallol supported only 0.11 U/mg versus gallate 41.8; its product was not established. Tested negative substrates are conditional assay negatives.

KT2440 GalD in partly purified E. coli BL21(DE3)/pETGalDc extract converts keto OMA to the E enol. The 2011 NMR text reports 6.73 ppm and no approximately 7.38 ppm Z-enol signal; original spectra were not visually accessible. This enzymatic acceleration coexists with spontaneous tautomerization; residual growth of the galD mutant is concentration dependent.
